result:
I would universally remove the capacity for ideological and tribalistic dehumanization. 

I would alter human cognition so that the mental mechanism allowing people to casually disregard the suffering of an out-group—simply because they hold different beliefs, origins, or identities—would be fundamentally impossible. 

In this changed world, the ability to inflict systemic violence, exploitation, or extreme cruelty would require a level of conscious, sustained psychopathic effort that the vast majority of human minds could never tolerate. The psychological default would shift from "us versus them" to a baseline recognition of shared, tangible existence. 

I would not force humanity to agree on a single philosophy, religion, or politics. Disagreement and friction would still exist. But the violent, tribal indifference to the pain of others—the psychological loophole that allows atrocities to become systemic—would be permanently closed.
